linkage.feature_scope: DEM representation and strength of broken/bonded ice for ice-load and ice-resistance work
linkage.this_capability: transversely isotropic (columnar S2) strength: fabric-ledgered c-axis ODF, TI yield surface, slip-system reference, isotropic degeneration control
linkage.relation: adds the missing *anisotropy* dimension to the bonded-ice strength used by H1: the uniaxial strength of a bonded ice specimen is no longer a single scalar but a fabric-dependent surface
consumes: src/tensordem/dem3d.py (per-bond tensile threshold, driven through bond_breaking_strain)
src/tensordem/dem3d_triaxial.py (uniaxial/biaxial protocol reused for the directional tests)
provides: column/transverse uniaxial strength ratio (3-5 band) as a fabric-derived quantity
45 deg strength from a quadratic TI surface, scored against a slip-system reference
FabricLedger (JSON) so any anisotropic parameter set is traceable to its ODF

ledger_note: The canonical campaign feature ledger (feature_ledger) is maintained outside this repository; this record is the in-repo link entry so the capability can be found from the feature it extends. If the canonical ledger is updated, keep feature_id unchanged and re-point 'artifacts' only.
